# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

The WordList project is committed to a welcoming, respectful community for everyone, regardless of background or identity. Participants should help keep project spaces constructive and free from harassment.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate and respectful.
- Discuss ideas and code on their merits.
- Accept constructive feedback and differing viewpoints.
- Respect other participants' privacy and boundaries.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, or personal attacks.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Deliberate disruption, intimidation, or repeated abusive conduct.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or reject contributions that violate this policy and may restrict a participant's access to project spaces. Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers through [the apimgr GitHub organization](https://github.com/apimgr). Do not use the public issue tracker for sensitive reports.

This policy is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
